title: Overseas fab P&L tracker: revenue, profit and depreciation of new-site fab subsidiaries (TSMC Arizona/JASM/ESMC/Nanjing, Samsung Austin/Taylor, SK hynix Wuxi, Micron Hiroshima)
why_it_matters: TSMC's 2025 annual report shows TSMC Arizona profitable and JASM loss-making; subsidiary accounts are the only public, audited view of what new fabs outside home bases actually earn.
questions: What are annual revenue, operating income, net income and depreciation of each overseas fab subsidiary since start-up?
How are government grants booked in these subsidiaries (other income vs reduced PP&E)?
How do Korean and US memory makers disclose their foreign fab subsidiaries' results?
primary_sources: Samsung Electronics / SK hynix audit reports (DART) subsidiary notes

title: Fab electricity and water tariffs by site: Taipower industrial rates, US utility special contracts (APS/SRP, Oncor, National Grid NY), Kyushu Electric, German industrial power, Gujarat
why_it_matters: Energy can be up to 30% of fab opex and Taiwan's industrial tariffs rose sharply after 2024; no sourced site-level comparison exists in the atlas.
questions: What industrial tariffs and special-contract terms apply to each major fab site?
How have Taiwan industrial rates changed since 2022 for the highest-consumption users?
What share of fab opex is energy at each site?
primary_sources: Arizona Corporation Commission and Texas PUC filings
Gujarat Electricity Regulatory Commission tariff orders
